h2: About Journal Entry Aggregation
p: Journal Entry Aggregation prepares summary data so the Trial Balance Report uses pre-baked data instead of aggregating every day.
h2: Aggregation job and report data
p: The aggregation job populates the tables that reports read from. Before the job runs, reports must check for null values in those tables.
The post snapshot delta data query includes journal entries where:

ul.li: the latest aggregated date is null or submitted_on_date is later than the latest aggregated date
submitted_on_date is earlier than the end date

p: The summary snapshot baseline data query includes aggregated journal entries where:

ul.li: aggregated_on_date is on or before the latest aggregated date

h2: Charge off journal entries
p: Charge off journal entries record how the interest, fees, and penalty portions of a charged-off loan map to income and receivable accounts. The mapping depends on whether the charge off is classified as Fraud or Non Fraud.

tr.td: Interest income charge off, Interest Receivable
Fee Charge off, Fee Receivable, charge-off fees Income
Fee Charge off, Fee Receivable, charge-off Penalty Income

h2: Charge adjustment journal entries
p: Charge adjustment journal entries map each charge portion to income and liability accounts.

tr.td: Fee Income, Fee Charge off, income from fees, charge-off fees Income
Fee Income, Other Credit liability, income from fees, Overpayment Liability
Fee Income, Fee Charge off, income from penalties, charge-off Penalty Income

h2: OCA Repayment journal entries
p: OCA Repayment journal entries post the interest, fees, penalty, and Unallocated Credit portions of a repayment to their respective accounts.

tr.td: Other receivables, recoveries, fund source /advance accounting, Income from Recovery payment
Other receivables, recoveries, fund source /advance accounting, Income from Recovery payment
Other receivables, recoveries, fund source /advance accounting, Income from Recovery payment
Other receivables, Other Credit liability, fund source /advance accounting, Overpayment Liability

h2: Ownership sale and buyback journal entries
p: Ownership sale and buyback journal entries record the movement of a loan balance between the investor and PayPal accounts at the close of business on the settlement date.
The system passes general ledger entries for the loan balance amount at the close of business of the settlement date:

ul.li: For a sale of ownership: DR Loan/Fee Rec-Investor CR Loan/Fee Rec-PayPal.

h2: Asset sale and buyback journal entries
p: At close of business (COB), the system posts asset sale and asset buyback transactions using the closing balance of the loan account. Each transaction creates two journal entries: DR 145600, CR 112601/112603 and DR 112601/112603, CR 145600. The system publishes events for both journal entries.

tr.td: Previous inactive ownership records and no active ownership record

h2: Transaction refund and provisional credit cash in
p: Transaction refund and provisional credit cash in posts cash received for interest, late fees, NSF fees, snooze fees, principal or unallocated credit to the fund source account and credits the matching receivable or liability account.
h2: Transaction refund and provisional credit cash in with Y flag
p: Transaction Refund/Provisional Credit Cash in with Y flag posts repayment journal entries for interest, late fees, NSF fees, snooze fees, principal and unallocated credit. Each entry debits account 145023 (Fund source) and credits the account shown below.
h2: Transaction refund and provisional credit cash out with Y flag
p: Transaction Refund/Provisional Credit Cash Out with Y flag posts a cash-out journal entry for interest, late fees, NSF fees, snooze fees, principal or unallocated credit. The debit account and label depend on the payment type; the credit account and label are always Fund source.
h2: Transaction refund and provisional credit cash out with Y and Y flags
p: Transaction Refund/Provisional Credit Cash Out with Y and Y flags posts a debit to an income or expense account and a credit to Fund source account 145023.
h2: Good will no cash journal entries
p: Good will no cash journal entries record goodwill credit postings that do not move cash. Each entry debits an income or expense account and credits a receivable, liability or loan portfolio account, with status pass. The debit and credit labels depend on the fee type or principal payment.

tr.td: Good Will Late Fee Payment No Cash
Good Will NSF Fee Payment No Cash
Good Will Snooze Fee Payment No Cash
Good Will Principal Payment No Cash
Good Will Unallocated Credit (UNC) No Cash

h2: Good will no cash journal entries with Y flag
p: Good will no cash journal entries with a Y flag record goodwill credit income without moving cash. Each entry debits one goodwill income account and credits the recovery repayment account.

tr.td: Good Will Interest - Repayment No Cash with Y flag
Good Will Late Fee Payment No Cash with Y flag
Good Will NSF Fee Payment No Cash with Y flag
Good Will Snooze Fee Payment No Cash with Y flag
Good Will Principal Payment No Cash with Y flag

h2: Late fee waiver journal entries
p: Late fee waiver journal entries record how waived late fees move between penalty income and receivable accounts without cash changing hands. The entry depends on whether the Y flag and Y and Y flags are set.
h2: NSF fee waiver journal entries
p: NSF fee waiver journal entries post without cash and use four flag combinations.
h2: Auto payment interest repayment cash in
p: Auto Payment Interest - Repayment Cash in posts each payment type to its own receivable or liability account, always debiting Fund source 145023.
Each payment type credits the account shown:
h2: Auto payment interest repayment cash in with Y flag
p: Late Fee Payment, NSF Fee Payment, Snooze Fee Payment and Principal Payment credit Income from Recovery Repayment 744008. Unallocated Credit (UNC) credits Over payment liability 245000.
h2: Auto payment interest repayment cash out with Y flag
p: For an Auto Payment Interest - Repayment Cash Out transaction with the Y flag, each payment type posts to its own receivable or liability account and credits Fund source 145023.
h2: Auto payment interest repayment cash out with both Y flags
p: For an Auto Payment Interest - Repayment Cash Out transaction with both Y flags, each payment type posts to Income from Recovery Repayment 744008 and Fund source 145023.
h2: Scheduled payment interest repayment cash in
p: A Scheduled Payment Interest - Repayment Cash in transaction without the Y flag posts each payment type to its own debit and credit accounts. The debit always comes from Fund source 145023.
h2: Scheduled payment interest repayment cash in with Y flag
